name: Celine
source:
A demon. Of celestial and fairy descent who is Coline's half-sister. Ten years ago, she tried to kill Anduke, whom she met at the water mill. She is the one who released the seal on the demons and filled the world with fear. Her true identity is that of a lonely woman starving for warm love.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071230090604fw_/http://www.mink.co.jp/lineup/dangel/chara.html]Mink[/url]]
